channel.title: Open Transit Engineering & Architecture
channel.description: Technical articles, benchmarks, and architecture guides for high-performance GTFS transit engines.

item.title: Engineering Sub-100ms Public Transit Timetables with Static Astro & Open GTFS Data
item.description: Architectural breakdown of compiling relational GTFS feeds into static edge assets, powering Stopwatch (https://transit.shivrajsinh.in) and Headway (https://headway.shivrajsinh.in) with sub-100ms TTFB.

item.title: How We Index 200,000+ Transit Routes and Stops Without Blowing Google's Crawl Budget
item.description: Systems engineering approach for programmatic transit SEO, sitemap partitioning, IndexNow batching, and canonicalization across Headway (https://headway.shivrajsinh.in) and Stopwatch (https://transit.shivrajsinh.in).

item.title: Real-Time Bus Tracking Architecture: GTFS-RT Protobuf Ingestion at Scale
item.description: Low-latency streaming of vehicle GPS coordinates and arrival delays via Protocol Buffers and Server-Sent Events, deployed across Stopwatch (https://transit.shivrajsinh.in) and Headway (https://headway.shivrajsinh.in).
